news.headline: Kellen Moore gets a statue at Boise State
news.summary: Boise State unveiled a bronze statue of the Saints head coach at its stadium on Saturday night. Moore played quarterback there and won 50 of his 53 starts.

news.headline: Gayle Benson thanks the fans who went to Paris
news.summary: The Saints owner wrote an open letter to everyone who made the trip to France for Sunday's game. She said the score did not go their way, but New Orleans was represented well.

news.headline: The Saints are off this week and looking at everything
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said the bye week is for a top-to-bottom look at the team, starting with its slow starts. The Saints have been outscored 44 to 6 in the first quarter this season.

news.headline: Georgia beats Florida 27-8
news.summary: Florida lost the ball four times on Saturday, and one of those turnovers went back 66 yards for a Georgia touchdown. The Gators did not score until the fourth quarter and are now 5-3.

news.headline: Florida used two quarterbacks against Georgia
news.summary: Aaron Philo started and came out after throwing two interceptions early. Tramell Jones Jr. finished the game and ran in Florida's only touchdown.

news.headline: Coach Sumrall tells Florida fans he is sorry
news.summary: Jon Sumrall apologized to Florida fans after Saturday's loss. He said the team has to be a lot better in every part of the game.

news.headline: Tulane beats Charlotte 38-31 in overtime
news.summary: Tulane was behind by 10 points in the fourth quarter Friday night and tied the game with 10 seconds left. Dagan Bruno ran it in from the 1-yard line in overtime to win it, and the Green Wave are 4-4.

news.headline: Trace Johnson ties the game with 10 seconds left
news.summary: Tulane's freshman quarterback threw an 11-yard touchdown pass to Cameron Roberts to make it 31-31. In his first start on the road he completed 28 of his 36 throws for 284 yards.

news.headline: TJ Smith returns a kickoff 95 yards for a touchdown
news.summary: Smith took a second-quarter kickoff 95 yards to the end zone and put Tulane ahead 14-10. Charlotte led 24-14 by halftime anyway, so Tulane had to come back again in the fourth quarter.
